contract_terms.basis: recorded by mt5desk.tape.record_contract_terms at `observed_at`: the stamp IS when the desk knew it

cot.basis: the same CFTC release as cot_fx

cot_fx.basis: owned_data._COT_PUBLICATION_LAG_DAYS = 4: Friday release, Saturday under every DST/broker-clock combination

cross_asset_anchors.valid: the market day the print refers to

eur_cot_blocked.basis: the same CFTC release as cot_fx

event_calendar.basis: assumed, conservative: a calendar is published ahead of the event, so the schedule is known before it; a DAY-precision `event_date` anchors the reaction window at 00:00 and is the flagged risk

fred_macro.basis: orthogonal_sweep.MACRO_PUBLICATION_LAG_D = 1 day, plus the broker offset; monthly releases are admissible only through data/vintages

gdelt.basis: 15-minute update cadence; one bar is conservative

lbma_vaults.basis: LBMA publishes vault holdings with a one-month lag on the 5th business day

macro_state.basis: assumed, conservative: a snapshot is known when it was written, so it is admissible ONLY from its own `updated` stamp forward and never broadcast onto earlier bars

microstructure_surface.basis: assumed, conservative: a per-symbol spread/activity surface summarised from the tape up to its build time; conditioning earlier bars on it reads a summary that includes later ticks -- a cost-shape input, flagged until it is rebuilt per-bar

mt5_h1_universe.valid: H1 bar open (broker time under UTC tzinfo)
mt5_h1_universe.basis: known at the bar's close, one bar after its stamp

sge_benchmark.basis: the PM fix prints 15:30 CST; next day is unambiguous

spdr_gld_holdings.basis: published the same US evening: usable next day

swiss_customs_gold.basis: FOCBS monthly trade data, about three weeks after month end

tick_tape.basis: the venue's own ticks, stamped on receipt (`ts`); a resampled hour is labelled at its open and read by families on closed bars

IR3TIB01JPM156N.valid: first day of the reference month
IR3TIB01JPM156N.basis: assumed, conservative: OECD MEI monthly, month-start stamp, released one to two months later

PCOPPUSDM.valid: first day of the reference month
PCOPPUSDM.basis: assumed, conservative: IMF primary commodity prices, monthly, stamped at month START and released the following month

WALCL.basis: assumed, conservative: H.4.1 prints Thursday 16:30 ET for Wednesday
